title: Extraordinary experience, magnificent facilities
text:
An extraordinary experience, whether you like aviation or are related to it, or if you are totally unfamiliar with the subject.

This is a perfect complement, and my admiration for commercial pilots is even greater knowing their work minimally.

The facilities are magnificent and the simulator is incredibly detailed. 

I recommend it without hesitation, because the value for money is also very good. 

Also, I think it is a great gift to give, whether you like aviation or have nothing to do with it.
author: Foxbravo

title: Good flight experience to recommend 🛫
text:
Recommended 👍 A good experience of how to fly a plane, plus a flight instructor accompanied us throughout the entire trip, as well as helping us manage and learn the handling and control.
Rodolfo the instructor was very kind and professional at all times.
author: josedavidb757

title: Very cool experience for children
text: I decided to gift it to my child as a common gift from his classmates for his birthday; the experience was fantastic, the management of the purchase and reservation was very easy, and the experience itself was very cool; the child left very excited and delighted with it. I appreciate that even though it wasn't for the sister, she was allowed to participate; the explanation was very engaging and tailored to her age of 6 years, and we all learned a lot. Thank you 😊
author: rosam_a915

title: Touch & Go Experience
text: I had another experience before with Heranfly and it was very good, this time it has also been incredible. I want to thank Rodolfo, who is a true professional, for the great experience I had. He explains everything in detail, is super friendly and attentive, and I will definitely repeat this soon... it is an experience to try without hesitation.
author: U6203DUluisv

title: Authentic.
text: An authentic show and a pleasure to enjoy such a professional and genuine experience. Never better said, it flies by and offers you the chance to take the controls of a commercial airplane and feel like a pilot for a moment. Francisco made the experience very enjoyable, authentic, and enriching for someone who is passionate about this world.
author: destinospasaje1

title: Great experience.
text: It was for my 12 y/o son’s birthday present of flight simulator. The instructor was very knowledgeable and accommodating for language and age.
author: Marlena i

title: A high-flying experience
text: It has been an incredible experience, I have nothing but words of thanks for Rodolfo, the pilot who accompanied us during the flight, professional, patient, always with a smile, you can see that he is passionate about his job and that he tries to infect your enthusiasm, certainly with us he got it, we made two flights one calmer, another with incidents and we could not enjoy more, we were without any knowledge about aviation and we left delighted, I recommend it 100% and Rodolfo, we threatened to return.
author: R3533MLanaa

title: EXCEPTIONAL FLIGHT SIMULATORS
text: It has been a gift from Reyes for my 14-year-old nephew, who since childhood is passionate about flying airplanes and everything that surrounds the world of aviation, plays piloting games since childhood... and has come out of the experience delighted and very excited!! It's been amazing for both him, my sister and me, that we were with him.
